units.reason: New test-only benchmark helper; cannot affect production behavior.
units.headline: Add helper building a head DB for selected-series benchmarks
units.summary: Opens a DB with compactions disabled and appends totalSeries series with samplesPerSeries samples at ts 0..n-1, committing every 10k series, and returns refs in append order. Test-only code, so a line-by-line review is unnecessary; the 1000-sample guard correctly keeps samples within one 1000ms chunk range.

units.reason: New test-only helper used only by benchmarks.
units.headline: Add helper sampling refs at even intervals for benchmarks
units.summary: Returns a copy of all refs when count >= len, otherwise count refs at floor(i*len/count) indices, which stay in bounds and sorted. Test-only, so no production impact.

units.reason: New benchmark only; no production code path affected.
units.headline: Benchmark CompactSelectedSeries across selected-series fractions
units.summary: Rebuilds a 100k-series DB per iteration with the timer stopped, then times CompactSelectedSeries over 100% down to 0.1% of series. Benchmark-only; the doc claim that evicted series cannot be reused holds since the DB is rebuilt each iteration.

risk_signals: persistence: writes blocks and evicts head series
units.reason: New exported method that writes blocks and evicts head series; correctness affects data durability.
units.headline: New CompactSelectedSeries persists and evicts caller-chosen head series
units.summary: Adds an exported DB method that sorts and dedupes caller refs, filters out series with OOO data, writes blocks tagged FromSelectedSeries for each chunk range via compactHeadViewLocked, then evicts those series using an append-ID watermark. It mutates persistent state and the head outside the regular compaction cycle, so eviction correctness determines whether samples can be lost.
focus: truncateSelectedSeries skips series that received samples after the committedAppendID watermark, including when isolation is disabled
FromSelectedSeries blocks are excluded from inOrderBlocksMaxTime and never merged with regular blocks, so WAL replay cutoff is not advanced
Refs not present in the head (already gc'd or bogus) are handled by filterSeriesAndSortPostings without error, and are counted in num_skipped_ooo
Holding db.cmtx across a full head-range scan and block writes blocks regular compaction for the duration

issues.title: Skipped count mislabels missing refs as OOO skips
issues.failure_scenario: Caller passes refs of series already garbage-collected from the head; if the filter drops them, the log reports them as num_skipped_ooo although none had OOO data, misleading operators.
issues.detail: The difference counts every ref dropped by the filter, not only OOO ones.

units.reason: New test only; adds coverage without changing production code.
units.headline: Test single-timestamp head is compacted and evicted
units.summary: Appends one sample at t=1000 so head MinTime == MaxTime, then checks CompactSelectedSeries writes exactly one block and evicts the series. New test, covering the inclusive loop bound in compactHeadViewLocked.

units.reason: New test only; asserts empty input is a no-op.
units.headline: Test nil and empty refs are no-ops
units.summary: Checks that nil and empty ref slices return nil, write no blocks, and do not increment the triggered counter, matching the early return before the metric increment. New test, no production impact.
